descriptions.warehouses: Your workspace owns every warehouse below it, who may enter them, and who may administer the workspace itself.
descriptions.workspaceRoles: Workspace roles decide who may administer this workspace. They never grant anything inside a warehouse.
descriptions.members: Workspace members administer the workspace. Everyone else here belongs to a warehouse but holds no workspace role.
descriptions.permissions: The workspace permission catalogue. Every permission here decides a workspace capability and never grants anything inside a warehouse.

nameWorkspace.title: Name your workspace
nameWorkspace.description: A workspace is created without a name. Naming it replaces the placeholder everyone currently sees.
nameWorkspace.descriptionRename: The new name replaces the current one for everyone in this workspace.
nameWorkspace.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Control characters are rejected; names need not be unique.

warehouses.empty: This workspace has no warehouse yet.

add.title: Add a warehouse
add.description: The warehouse is created inside this workspace and you become its warehouse manager.
add.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Two warehouses may share a name.
add.noticeDescription: Creating a warehouse makes you its manager. Nobody else can be placed in it until you define roles there.

detail.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Warehouse names need not be unique.
detail.peopleDescription: Giving access places a person in this warehouse with a role defined there. What they may do inside it is decided by that role, not by the workspace — manage those roles on the warehouse's Access page.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.description: Archiving withdraws a warehouse from operation. It is reversible.
archive.stopsDescription: {{name}} stops being selectable and refuses every change to what it holds.
archive.keptDescription: Its roles, memberships and records are retained and stay readable, and it keeps exactly one manager so it stays administrable when restored.

archived.alertDescription: Its roles, memberships and records stay readable. Nothing inside it can be changed until it is restored.

lastWarehouse.alertDescription: It is the only warehouse of this workspace still in operation, and a workspace always keeps one, so its members are never left without a site to work in.

giveAccess.title: Give warehouse access
giveAccess.description: Place someone from this workspace into one of its warehouses with a role defined there.
giveAccess.roleDescription: You can see this warehouse's role names in order to choose one. This gives you no other authority inside it.
giveAccess.noticeDescription: That role changes only through the warehouse's own transfer, and you cannot place yourself into a warehouse that already has members.

withdrawAccess.title: Withdraw access to {{name}}?
withdrawAccess.description: The person stops belonging to this warehouse. Their other memberships are unchanged.
withdrawAccess.protectedReason: The warehouse manager's access is withdrawn only through the warehouse's own transfer.

workspaceRoles.empty: This workspace has no custom workspace role yet.

editor.nameDescription: 1–100 characters, unique in this workspace. Differently cased names are distinct.
editor.permissionsDescription: Changes apply to the next authorization decision. None of these permissions grant anything inside a warehouse.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{count}} workspace members hold this role. Every one of them moves to the replacement in the same step.
delete.replacementDescription: Every workspace member holds exactly one workspace role, so a replacement is required.
delete.noticeDescription: Moving members is a role assignment, so deleting an assigned role needs delete and assign permission together.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer workspace ownership
transferOwnership.description: Ownership moves in one step. The workspace always has exactly one owner.
transferOwnership.newOwnerDescription: Must already be a workspace member.
transferOwnership.newRoleDescription: You must end the transfer holding exactly one workspace role.
transferOwnership.noticeDescription: After this you can no longer transfer ownership, and only the new owner can transfer it back.

members.heading: Workspace members
members.description: {{count}} people hold a workspace role. Each holds exactly one.
members.empty: This workspace has no workspace member yet.

changeRole.title: Change the workspace role of {{name}}
changeRole.roleDescription: Every workspace member holds exactly one workspace role.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the workspace?
remove.description: They keep the warehouses they belong to and stop administering this workspace.

add.title: Add a workspace member
add.description: Only people who already belong to a warehouse of this workspace can be made workspace members.

everyone.heading: Everyone in this workspace
everyone.description: People who belong to a warehouse of this workspace. Only they can be made workspace members — and any of them can be given access to another warehouse.
everyone.blockedNote: {{name}} belongs to no warehouse of this workspace yet, so they cannot be made a workspace member until they are given access to one.

permissions.heading: Workspace permissions
permissions.description: The workspace permission catalogue. None of these permissions grant anything inside a warehouse.
permissions.reservedNote: Transferring ownership is reserved for the protected Workspace owner role and cannot be added to a custom role.

authorityLost.title: Your workspace authority changed
authorityLost.description: Your workspace role changed while this page was open. The controls you may still use have been refreshed.
